RUSTSEC-2026-0548.fixBlockedBy: tauri-plugin-updater 2.13.1 pins zip ^4 (Windows-only, optional); patched zip >= 9.0.5 is a semver-incompatible major
RUSTSEC-2026-0548.reason: zip is pulled in only as an optional Windows target dependency of tauri-plugin-updater (cargo tree -i zip --target all); it is not compiled on macOS or Linux. Lance never calls ZipArchive/ZipStreamReader and never extracts untrusted ZIPs: update bundles are delivered by Tauri's updater and verified with the pinned minisign public key before install. The parser-differential exploit requires an application that inspects with ZipArchive and extracts with ZipStreamReader, which Lance does not do. Revisit when a stable tauri-plugin-updater release accepts zip >= 9.0.5; a Windows update-bundle extraction path would then need review.

RUSTSEC-2023-0071.reason: Not compiled into the binary. Present in Cargo.lock only through sqlx-mysql, which is disabled because tauri-plugin-sql is declared with features = ["sqlite"], `cargo tree -i rsa -e normal --target all` reports no reverse dependencies. Lance performs no RSA or PKCS#1 signature verification anywhere; update signatures are minisign (Ed25519) via tauri-plugin-updater. RustCrypto has published no patched version for this advisory, so there is nothing to upgrade to. Re-verify with that cargo tree probe when tauri-plugin-sql is next bumped.

RUSTSEC-2024-0363.reason: Not applicable to Lance's stack. GHSA-xmrp-424f-vfpx covers the Postgres and MySQL binary wire protocol types, where truncated or overflowing casts are reinterpreted as wire-format values. Lance is SQLite-only: tauri-plugin-sql is declared with features = ["sqlite"] and the frontend plugin config preloads sqlite:lance.db, so no Postgres or MySQL code path is compiled in. A fix does exist at sqlx 0.8.1 and cannot be taken because tauri-plugin-sql pins sqlx 0.8.0, so this is recorded with fixBlockedBy rather than silently ignored. Revisit when tauri-plugin-sql publishes a release allowing sqlx >= 0.8.1; at that point delete this entry and bump.
